items.label: Teleport to waypoint
items.desc: Use the menu waypoint first, otherwise the game radar waypoint. Requires the exterior world and a successful ground query. On-foot only; live gameplay acceptance pending.

items.label: Teleport to coordinates
items.desc: Use X, Y and Z coordinates with optional ground snapping. Invalid or unloaded destinations are rejected. On-foot only; live gameplay acceptance pending.

items.label: Back
items.desc: Return to the previous teleport position in this session. On-foot only; live gameplay acceptance pending.

items.label: Save current position
items.desc: Remember your current position for the current session. On-foot only; live gameplay acceptance pending.

items.label: Teleport to saved position
items.desc: Return to a saved session position. On-foot only; live gameplay acceptance pending.

items.label: Copy current coordinates
items.desc: Fill the coordinate controls with your current position. On-foot only; live gameplay acceptance pending.

items.label: Set menu waypoint
items.desc: Choose a menu waypoint; you can also right-click the world map. On-foot only; live gameplay acceptance pending.
